summary: Tested UI flow improvements for Projects page. All requested features verified: Project cards show Company Name as title, Project Name as subtitle, SOW button visible on cards, clicking SOW/card opens Project Detail with SOW tab as default, status dropdowns with 'Not Applicable' option visible.

issues: Data loading error shown on initial load - 'Something went wrong' error displayed. This appears to be a transient issue as the API returns data correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: UI flow improvements for Projects page verified. Project cards now show Company Name (client_name) as title and Project Name as subtitle. SOW button is visible on each card. Clicking either the card or SOW button navigates to /projects/{projectId} which shows Project Detail page with SOW Delivery tab as default. The SOW Delivery tab shows scopes with status dropdowns including 'Not Applicable' option.
